_comment: Monuments (game/monuments.py, v0.68.0): statues and the like, each with its story. name: the heading (look command, travel-to). look: what the look command says. title: the reading window's title. text: its lines (each wrapped to the window; "" for a blank line) (walk into the monument to read them). A map places one with ';monument=x,y id' (tools/city_plan/build_city.py writes Bytorsskug's). The facts are the user's lore; THE WORDING IS A DRAFT by the assistant, for the user to rewrite.

whisper_poet.name: Whisper Poet's statue
whisper_poet.look: A bronze statue of a tall Bermann woman, her head turned a little to the north, towards Myligast, as if she were listening for something.
whisper_poet.title: Whisper Poet
text: The bronze is old and green at the edges, and polished smooth where the plaza's children have climbed it. She stands with her head turned a little to the north, towards Myligast, as if listening.
The plaque at her feet reads:
who heard the Tower's wind from the western deserts
and walked alone through the miasma to find it.
She came to Bytorsskug in Turn 134.
The road she walked is the Towerway. Before her, nobody in the west knew there was a city here.
